title:
Public API for the Webpack type.

This type is separate from the Webpack type to provide a runtime-agnostic
interface to the webpack bundler.

The Webpack type, being a NodeJS-specific implementation, can only run by
dispatching a node process and this interface serves as a dispatcher of
those actions without starting an ActionEngine directly. This is important
because this way we can use a single NodeJS action (Webpack.sharedRuntimeExecutor)
and reuse the installed dependencies between all these different actions.
